questions.question: Did added hydroxychloroquine show better one-year survival in this pancreatic-cancer trial?

scope.form: Hydroxychloroquine added to gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel
scope.cancer_model: 112 untreated advanced or metastatic pancreatic cancer patients; randomized 55 versus 57
scope.endpoint: Overall survival at 12 months; primary endpoint

questions.findings: No gain in length of life was shown. At one year, 41% were alive with the added drug and 49% with cancer drugs alone. Tumor response was higher with the added drug. A tumor response is not the same as longer life. Proof is in the short study report and Figures 2 and 3.
